mcpclients.title: Use with other AI tools
mcpclients.intro: SubaDubaLingo works with every AI tool that can start a local MCP server, and best with Claude. Pick your tool and copy the setup.
mcpclients.not_installed: Install SubaDubaLingo first: the setup points at the installed app.
mcpclients.claude_desktop.where: Press the button. Then quit Claude completely (right-click the Claude icon by the clock -> Quit) and open it again.
mcpclients.claude_code.where: Run the command in a terminal (PowerShell or Command Prompt), then start Claude Code again.
mcpclients.gemini.where: Paste it into %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\settings.json. If the file already has "mcpServers", add only the "subadubalingo" part. Then start Gemini CLI again.
mcpclients.codex.where: Paste it at the end of %USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml (create the file if there is none), then start Codex again.
mcpclients.vscode.where: In VS Code: Ctrl+Shift+P -> "MCP: Open User Configuration", and paste it. If the file already has "servers", add only the "subadubalingo" part. Use Copilot Chat in agent mode.
mcpclients.cursor.where: Paste it into %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\mcp.json. If the file already has "mcpServers", add only the "subadubalingo" part. Then restart Cursor.
